C0563.title: Woman Exploits Taobao 'Refund-Only' Rule by Refusing Partial Delivery to Keep Goods
C0563.summary: In January 2024, a woman in Wuhan, Hubei Province, purchased four items worth over 1,800 yuan from merchant Mr. Guan's Taobao store, using one account to chat and another to place the order while requesting the items be shipped in four separate parcels. After delivery she refused only one parcel, took the other three, yet successfully applied for a full 'refund-only', illegally retaining the goods. The merchant found this buyer had performed such operations over a thousand times and reported it to police.
